messages:
maria_sales: Customer wants a quick network answer for POC: prefer PrivateLink but security team still wants fallback IPs for hosted. Need a short how-to and sample rules to include in the security questionnaire.
jon_solutions: TL;DR: PrivateLink = interface endpoints (no public egress). Hosted = outbound to our public API over TLS 443 (requires egress allowlist or proxy). Recommend PrivateLink for strict egress policies.
ale_neteng: PrivateLink steps for customer: create interface endpoints in 2 AZs, attach to app subnets, set endpoint SG to allow inbound TCP 443 from app subnets, then share vpce ids for us to accept.
leo_eng: Hosted fallback: we can provide region egress IP ranges (small set) for firewalls. Note these are tied to our NAT fleet and may change between POC and GA — PrivateLink avoids that.
maria_sales: Security Q asks: do you support mTLS and can we do TLS inspection?
jon_solutions: mTLS: supported for Dedicated and Private (on-prem/VPC). Hosted API doesn't support customer mTLS by default. TLS inspection: if proxy terminates TLS, hosted API may fail. Use PrivateLink/Dedicated to avoid interception.
ale_neteng: Pasteable SG and firewall snippets for them: ```
# VPC Interface Endpoint SG (attach to ENIs)
Inbound: TCP 443 Source: 10.20.0.0/22  # replace with app subnet or app SG id
Outbound: All 0.0.0.0/0
``` ```
# Perimeter FW for Hosted API
Destination: 52.12.34.56/32, 35.67.89.10/32  # example egress IPs per region
Ports: TCP 443
Allow: app->api
```
maria_sales: They asked about DNS allowlist vs IPs. Which is preferred?
leo_eng: Both. DNS (api.redwood.ai) is easiest but many corp firewalls want IPs. Provide both and call out that PrivateLink removes DNS/IP churn.
jon_solutions: Quick test steps after they create endpoint: 1) verify SG allows 443 from app 2) curl the endpoint hostname we provide (we'll give an internal health path) 3) share vpce ids so we can accept service on our side.
infra-bot: placeholder service-name created for POC: com.amazonaws.vpce-svc-0b1c2d3e4f :gear:
maria_sales: Action items: I'll get confirmed egress IPs from infra and attach this snippet to the security questionnaire. @ale_neteng please draft a one-pager we can hand to their Infosec with steps + risks (TLS inspect, IP churn, mTLS support).
ale_neteng: On it, will include migration note: switching from Hosted->PrivateLink requires DNS and client endpoint updates.
jon_solutions: FYI - if customer uses an outbound HTTP proxy that requires auth, we recommend PrivateLink or a Dedicated deployment where we can integrate with their proxy architecture.
maria_sales: Thanks team — will send to Acme sec team and update thread when they reply.
